one_liner: Cloud database platform providing administrative APIs, SDKs, and developer tools to manage clusters and databases.
access_notes: MongoDB Atlas offers a free-forever tier (M0) and self-serve sign-up to obtain API credentials.
verdict_reason: MongoDB Atlas provides self-serve accounts with a free tier, fully documented REST APIs, Go SDKs, and an official MCP server.
